description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the AuthProviderDao class within the OrangeHRM OpenID Authentication plugin. It contains unit tests for various DAO methods such as retrieval, save, delete, and count operations related to OpenID providers.

classes.name: AuthProviderDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the AuthProviderDao methods for managing OpenID providers and their details.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test method executes by loading fixture data.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an AuthProvider by its ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderDetailsByProviderId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of detailed provider information based on provider ID.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviders
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of providers with pagination settings.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderCount
methods.description: Tests counting the total number of providers matching certain criteria.

methods.name: testDeleteProviders
methods.description: Tests deletion (logical or physical) of providers by ID.

methods.name: testSaveProvider
methods.description: Tests saving a new OpenIdProvider entity to the database.

methods.name: testSaveAuthProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Tests saving extra details linked to an existing OpenIdProvider.

methods.name: testGetAuthProvidersForLoginPage
methods.description: Tests fetching providers suitable for display on the login page.
